question: On the same cached expert observations, does a real checkpoint change that lowers the native action CFM objective also improve a separately specified endpoint action metric?

authorization_boundary.note: This protocol does not authorize obtaining weights or starting any remote operation. The baseline smoke test cannot attribute real SFT effects.

data.selection: Use the existing frozen cache and its canonical sample order; do not select observations using newly measured losses or endpoint errors.
data.dependence_note: Nearby anchors share trajectories and boundaries. Neither 36 anchors nor multiple noise draws are 36 independent tasks. No population-generalization claim from this screen.

required: Verify cache metadata and selected NPZ content hashes using VerifiedRawCache.
Record the checkpoint parameter-manifest identity, normalization-asset hash, model configuration, imported source paths and source hashes, and runtime versions.
Use the same local runtime, transforms, model settings, precision, batching and deployment sampler for both checkpoints if a future candidate comparison becomes possible.
Verify the loaded model's actual subtask conditioning mode against the checkpoint asset, rather than assuming the factory entry configuration is the final configuration.
Use the provided subtask; require subtask_source=provided. No generated subtask or temporal voting in this probe.
Require the expected native action target shape [1,32,32]. A different shape is an explicit protocol mismatch, not an automatic change of the metric.
identity_gate.cross_backend_rule: Do not compare newly measured CPU baseline losses or endpoints with old GPU candidate endpoints as a paired SFT effect. Old GPU summaries contain no CFM measurement.

native_cfm_measurement.interpretation: Deterministic evaluation of the training objective with augmentation/dropout disabled; not an asserted reproduction of stochastic logged training loss.
native_cfm_measurement.target_source: Canonical training dataset transforms applied to the original cached raw sample, retaining the recorded actions.
native_cfm_measurement.action_coordinates: Mapped delta actions, checkpoint normalization, and padding to 32 model dimensions, exactly as in the training transform chain.

rng.derivation: fold_in(fold_in(jax.random.key(seed), episode_index), frame_index), with seed=0 and identical keys across compared checkpoints; record the root key.
rng.namespace_note: This new probe deliberately reuses its CFM noise as the explicit endpoint initial noise. It differs from the old GPU/CPU pilot's PCG64 noise. Do not pair its endpoints with old pilot endpoints as a checkpoint effect.

reported_metrics.native_action_cfm_32x32: Official metrics['action_loss']: mean over all 32 time positions and all 32 model action dimensions; no current-subtask validity mask.
reported_metrics.native_joint_loss: Mean of the official returned per-step loss array; includes weighted subtask CE when enabled.
reported_metrics.subtask_ce: Official subtask_loss, subtask token count and configured subtask_loss_weight, reported separately. Do not call joint loss action CFM.
reported_metrics.valid23_prefix16_cfm: NOT MEASURED by the minimal API probe. The official scalar and per-step dimension-averaged loss cannot recover this region or a padding-only contribution. Do not infer such a decomposition.

native_cfm_measurement.parity_identity: native_joint_loss = native_action_cfm_32x32 + subtask_loss_weight * official_subtask_loss for these supervised batch-one samples, within the frozen engineering tolerance. Do not add CE again at every time position after reducing the returned array.

endpoint_measurement.source_api: Existing build_pi05 / SubtaskPolicy.infer path with an explicit recorded noise tensor
endpoint_measurement.sampler: Native sample_actions, ten Euler steps, t starts at 1 and dt=-0.1; no alternate solver or time reparameterization.
endpoint_measurement.initial_noise: Use the exact reconstructed float32 CFM internal noise tensor as the explicit endpoint initial noise, with batch dimension removed; save its hash. This is a new common-noise protocol, not the old PCG64 pilot draw.
endpoint_measurement.outputs: Save finite raw physical actions, physical GT and validity mask with hashes. Inverse normalization and mapped absolute-action conversion must match the existing policy output transforms.
endpoint_measurement.primary_mask: Position index < min(16,H) AND recorded current-subtask valid_mask. last_1 anchors contribute one valid position; they are not silently excluded.
endpoint_measurement.secondary_mask: All current-subtask-valid positions within the evaluated H=32 horizon.
endpoint_measurement.metrics: For each mask and action group, first average squared/absolute physical GT error over that sample's valid coordinates. For descriptive aggregation, average samples within each task and then average tasks. Preserve per-sample values and denominators.
endpoint_measurement.unit_rule: Report groups separately. Do not make a mixed-unit physical-action sum or compare the numerical size of physical MSE directly with normalized CFM.
endpoint_measurement.scope_rule: One noise draw measures that sampled action chunk, not the complete endpoint distribution. Distance between same-noise samples is not by itself a distance between distributions.

api_parity_and_negative_controls.name: canonical_training_input_parity
api_parity_and_negative_controls.test: For the provided-subtask case, compare canonical training-transformed observations with the effective inference-prepared observations at the model boundary: images, image masks, state, tokenized prompt/masks and action-conditioning fields. Keep GT actions only as the loss target.
api_parity_and_negative_controls.failure_meaning: Different conditioning or preprocessing; stop before interpreting a CFM/endpoint mismatch.

api_parity_and_negative_controls.name: joint_loss_accounting
api_parity_and_negative_controls.test: Check the official joint-loss identity and finite values; record action CFM and CE separately.
api_parity_and_negative_controls.failure_meaning: Loss accounting or configuration mismatch; not evidence about SFT.

api_parity_and_negative_controls.name: same_model_same_rng_repeat
api_parity_and_negative_controls.test: On at least the first canonical sample, repeat the same checkpoint with identical CFM root key and endpoint initial noise. Reuse a single loaded model. CFM values and physical endpoints must agree within the frozen engineering tolerance.
api_parity_and_negative_controls.failure_meaning: Uncontrolled stochasticity or a stateful inference mismatch; no candidate attribution.

api_parity_and_negative_controls.name: target_is_not_an_inference_input
api_parity_and_negative_controls.test: Check the canonical model-boundary inference observation does not include GT actions or future observations. If a modified-GT diagnostic is performed, identical observation and endpoint noise must yield the same action; only target-based scores may change.

api_parity_and_negative_controls.name: mask_scope_control
api_parity_and_negative_controls.test: Offline endpoint reaggregation under full-valid and prefix16-valid masks must use saved predictions without re-running the model. Neither reporting mask changes native 32x32 CFM.

api_parity_and_negative_controls.name: different_noise_same_checkpoint
api_parity_and_negative_controls.test: Only if the local time budget permits, use an additional recorded noise draw with unchanged weights to describe measurement variability. Such differences are never labeled a checkpoint effect.
api_parity_and_negative_controls.failure_meaning: No directional scientific expectation; this is a variability control, not a test that different noises must change actions.

engineering_tolerance.interpretation: An API consistency threshold, not a performance/equivalence margin or a publication success threshold. Freeze before any candidate results. Investigate failures instead of relaxing after inspecting a candidate.

predeclared_decisions.api_pass_without_candidate: API_PASS_NO_SFT_CONCLUSION: all required parity controls pass on the selected baseline samples. This establishes measurement feasibility only.
predeclared_decisions.api_failure: API_MISMATCH: a required parity, identity or finiteness check fails. Do not interpret the scores scientifically.
predeclared_decisions.timeout: RESOURCE_INCONCLUSIVE: stop at 900 seconds; retain bounded logs and completed records, without claiming a model or scientific failure.
predeclared_decisions.future_candidate_loss_down_endpoint_grou: A descriptive mismatch for that fixed observation/noise/mask/group, if both changes exceed the engineering repeatability envelope. It does not imply that every action group worsens, that the endpoint distribution is unchanged, or that a gauge direction caused the update.
Descriptive agreement on these chosen metrics and probes; not proof that CFM caused the endpoint improvement or that closed-loop performance improved.
predeclared_decisions.future_candidate_mixed_groups_or_anchors: Report mixed evidence; do not manufacture a single direction through post-hoc group weighting or anchor exclusion.
predeclared_decisions.small_or_uncertain_change: Inconclusive. Lack of significance is not endpoint equivalence. With only one draw, claims concern fixed-noise scores; expected-loss claims require additional common draws with measurement uncertainty smaller than the reported effect.
predeclared_decisions.global_percentage_decomposition: Not identified. Do not report a percentage of CFM gain attributable to endpoint improvement versus gauge/path change. No such decomposition is defined by these measurements.

distribution_extension_not_enabled.noise_policy: Independent draws within each checkpoint, common draw identities across checkpoints, fixed before viewing candidate scores. More draws may be needed for adequate precision; two is only the algebraic minimum.
distribution_extension_not_enabled.proper_score: For a fixed sample/mask/group flatten the physical action coordinates and use d(x,y)=||x-y||_2/sqrt(number_of_coordinates). Unbiased energy-score estimate: mean_m d(X_m,y) - sum_{m!=n} d(X_m,X_n)/(2*M*(M-1)). Lower is better. Score each group separately.
distribution_extension_not_enabled.limitations: Repeated action samples with a single expert target do not identify every valid action distribution. Energy score is a predictive score against the sampled expert targets, not task reward, exact endpoint likelihood, or a proof of equality of endpoint distributions. Expected squared error alone is not a proper score for a non-degenerate predicted distribution.
distribution_extension_not_enabled.status: No distribution-quality or distribution-equivalence conclusion from the present one-noise smoke test. Any extension requires an explicit bounded execution plan.

publication_boundary: An analytic toy counterexample plus a baseline API check is not evidence that real SFT moves mainly in endpoint-invariant directions.
One small paired screen cannot establish a general explanation of unstable closed-loop fine-tuning gains.

A stronger contribution would require replicated real training comparisons on independent tasks/seeds, identified measurement uncertainty, and a prospective training or checkpoint-selection decision that improves independent closed-loop outcomes under matched data and compute.

No arbitrary percentage gain or correlation threshold is declared sufficient for a paper. Novelty must be assessed against existing flow objectives, endpoint-aware training, world-model supervision, and loss-versus-control studies.
